class.name: TerrainData
class.brief_description: The heights, painted layers, holes, tint and wetness of a [Terrain3D].

method.name: add_layer
method.description: Appends [param layer] to the layers and returns its index, or [code]-1[/code] if the terrain already has [constant MAX_LAYERS] layers.

method.name: add_region
method.description: Adds a flat region at [param height]. Returns [code]false[/code] if one is already there.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes every region. The layers are kept.

method.name: export_height_image
method.description: Returns the heights inside [param vertex_rect] as a [constant Image.FORMAT_RF] image in metres, or the whole terrain if [param vertex_rect] is empty. Missing regions read as [code]0.0[/code].

method.name: get_color
method.description: Returns the colour tint at [param vertex], with wetness in the alpha channel.

method.name: get_color_map
method.description: Returns the region's colour map, a [constant Image.FORMAT_RGBA8] image with tint in RGB and wetness in alpha, or [code]null[/code] if nothing has been painted in it.

method.name: get_height
method.description: Returns the stored height of [param vertex], or [code]NAN[/code] if no region covers it. A hole still has a stored height underneath, which is what this returns.

method.name: get_height_map
method.description: Returns the region's height map, a [constant Image.FORMAT_RF] image in metres, or [code]null[/code] if there is no such region.

method.name: get_height_range
method.description: Returns the lowest and highest heights anywhere in the terrain as [code]x[/code] and [code]y[/code].

method.name: get_hole_map
method.description: Returns the region's hole map, a [constant Image.FORMAT_R8] image where non-zero is a hole, or [code]null[/code] if the region has no holes.

method.name: get_layer
method.description: Returns the layer at [param index].

method.name: get_layer_count
method.description: Returns the number of layers.

method.name: get_layer_weights
method.description: Returns the painted weight of every possible layer at [param vertex], [constant MAX_LAYERS] values adding up to [code]1.0[/code].

method.name: get_region_coords
method.description: Returns the coordinates of every region.

method.name: get_region_count
method.description: Returns the number of regions.

method.name: get_splat_map
method.description: Returns one of the region's four splat maps: [constant Image.FORMAT_RGBA8] images holding the weights of layers [code]index * 4[/code] to [code]index * 4 + 3[/code]. Returns [code]null[/code] if none of those layers has been painted in the region.

method.name: get_vertex_bounds
method.description: Returns the rectangle of vertices covered by all the regions.

method.name: has_region
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if there is a region at [param region].

method.name: import_height_image
method.description: Writes the red channel of [param image] into the heights, with its top left pixel at [param vertex_offset], adding regions wherever the image reaches. If [param normalized] is [code]true[/code] the values are fractions mapped from [param min_height] to [param max_height]; otherwise they are used as metres. To import a 16-bit heightmap without losing precision, use the Terrain dock's Import Heightmap menu, since [method Image.load] reduces 16-bit PNG files to 8 bits.

method.name: is_hole
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param vertex] is a hole. Every triangle touching a hole vertex is left out of the mesh and the collision.

method.name: move_layer
method.description: Moves a layer to a new index, carrying its painted weights with it.

method.name: notify_region_changed
method.description: Tells terrains using this data that some of the region's maps changed. Only needed after writing into an image returned by one of the [code]get_*_map()[/code] methods directly; every other method here notifies by itself. [param maps] is a combination of [enum MapType] flags.

method.name: remove_layer
method.description: Removes a layer. Wherever it was painted, the other layers painted there take its share; where nothing else was, layer [code]0[/code] does.

method.name: remove_region
method.description: Removes a region and everything painted in it.

method.name: set_color
method.description: Sets the colour tint at [param vertex], with wetness in the alpha channel.

method.name: set_color_map
method.description: Replaces the region's colour map. See [method get_color_map] for the format.

method.name: set_height
method.description: Sets the height of [param vertex] in metres. The vertex must be inside a region.

method.name: set_height_map
method.description: Replaces the region's height map, adding the region if needed. The image must be [member region_size] pixels square and [constant Image.FORMAT_RF].

method.name: set_hole
method.description: Makes [param vertex] a hole, or fills it back in. Filling a hole restores the ground it had.

method.name: set_hole_map
method.description: Replaces the region's hole map. See [method get_hole_map] for the format.

method.name: set_layer
method.description: Replaces the layer at [param index], keeping what is painted with it.

method.name: set_layer_weights
method.description: Sets how much of each layer is painted at [param vertex], one value per layer. The weights are scaled to add up to [code]1.0[/code].

method.name: set_splat_map
method.description: Replaces one of the region's splat maps. See [method get_splat_map] for the format.

members.member: The layers, as stored. Edit them with [method add_layer], [method remove_layer] and [method move_layer], which keep the painted weights in step with the list.
The number of vertices along each side of a region. Each region is stored, uploaded and given collision as a unit. Can only be changed while there are no regions.
The regions, as stored. Use the region and map methods instead.

signal.name: layers_changed
signal.description: Emitted when a layer is added, removed, moved or changed.

signal.name: region_changed
signal.description: Emitted when a region's maps change. [param maps] is a combination of [enum MapType] flags.

signal.name: regions_changed
signal.description: Emitted when regions are added or removed.

constants.constant: The splat maps of layer weights.
The most layers a terrain can have.
